about: Career scenarios on Global, for the planner's career simulation (end-of-run SP) and scenario-aware card picks. Claude keeps this file. Each number is either sourced (see `sources`) or listed under `assumed`, which are estimates to tune when real careers disagree: log careers with their final SP in results/careers.md.

sources.gametora_ura: https://gametora.com/umamusume/ura-finals (base training values after the July 2026 Global update, fixed events, link character)
sources.gametora_unity: https://gametora.com/umamusume/unity-cup (Global base training values, unity training and Spirit Burst SP)
sources.gametora_trackblazer: https://gametora.com/umamusume/trackblazer (base training values, races-centred objectives, no scenario link)
sources.gametora_grand_concert: https://gametora.com/umamusume/our-grand-concert (base training values, link characters, lesson and live SP, lyrics-event golds)
sources.umareference_training: https://www.umareference.com/guide/support-cards-in-detail/calculating-training-stat-gain (training gain formula: mood 0.1 per step, +5% per support card)
sources.umareference_appearance: https://www.umareference.com/guide/support-cards-in-detail/stat-stick-passives (weights: 100 per facility, 50 for not appearing, specialty priority added to its own facility; community reverse-engineering)
sources.umamusumedb: https://umamusumedb.com/tools/training-calculator/ (facility level multipliers 1.0 to 2.0; friendship training at bond 80)
sources.game8_race: https://game8.co/games/Umamusume-Pretty-Derby/archives/572831 (race rewards at 1st place: G1 45 SP, G2/G3 35, OP/Pre-OP 30; Trackblazer 35/25/20)
sources.uma_guide_cms: knowledge/data/cm_schedule.json (which scenario was current for each Champions Meeting)

scenarios.name: URA Finale
scenarios.link_note: With an Aoi Kiryuin card, the Three-Legged Race event gives a Lv 3 hint for 鋼の意志 instead of Lv 1.

extra_sp.what: Three-Legged Race (50,000 fans by early November, year 2)
100,000 fans by the end of year 2
240,000 fans by the end of year 3
After the URA Finale Finals (scaled by race bonus)
Happy Meek duel wins, assumed 2 of 5 (30 SP each)

scenarios.card_note: Plain training scenario: training, friendship and specialty carry a deck.

scenarios.name: Unity Cup
scenarios.link_note: The story characters. Scenario-linked cards add +1 to every stat in unity training, and Spirit Bursts with them give 20/10 stats and 10 SP instead of 15/7 and 5. GameTora names Haru Urara as linked; the other three are the remaining story characters.

extra_sp.what: Unity (special) trainings, assumed 20 at 3 flames (3 SP each)
Spirit Bursts, assumed 8 (5 SP each, 10 with a linked card)
Extreme Spirit Bursts, assumed 4 (15 SP each, 20 with a linked card)
Team Zenith Declares War with 10 to 12 bursts

link_bonus.assumed: one extra Spirit Burst per linked card: +5 SP and +10/+3 stats over a normal burst, plus +1 per stat in about 10 unity trainings

scenarios.card_note: Team members on a facility (flames) matter as much as your cards; Pal cards can't join the team. Linked story characters burst for more.

scenarios.name: Trackblazer
scenarios.stat_caps_note: GameTora expected Global to start at 1200 each; JP's are 1200/1900/1200/1200/1500.
scenarios.optional_races_note: Assumed: the objectives need 660 Grade Points from races (G1 100 each), so careers race far more than in other scenarios.
scenarios.card_note: Races are the main source of stats and skill points, and race rewards scale with Race Bonus, so race bonus cards gain the most.

scenarios.name: Grand Concert
scenarios.link_note: Linked cards give more performance tokens. With a linked character's card, the lyrics event (16+ songs by early November, year 3) can give that character's gold hint.

extra_sp.what: Song lessons, assumed 22 learned (25 SP each, paid at the next live)
Live Technique lessons, assumed 44 (5 SP each)

scenarios.sp_per_training_note: Yume wo Kakeru! (after the 1st live) and Grow Up, Shine! (after the 2nd) add +2 and +3 Skill Pts to every later training; assumed both learned.

link_bonus.assumed: more performance tokens per training: about one extra song lesson (25 SP) and a technique lesson over a career

scenarios.event_chance_note: Assumed: the Support Event Chance Up live bonus.
scenarios.card_note: Lives add Friendship Bonus, Speciality Rate and Support Event Chance; linked cards fill the token needs and unlock their gold hints.
